title: MySQL: a table the LFC login can't SELECT shows as MISSING_TABLE_IN_SOURCE, not as a privilege error

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: MySQL 8.4.13, standard gateway, one run

symptom: With SELECT revoked on one table, schema exploration listed one table fewer (Found 1 table(s)). Its flow reported MISSING_TABLE_IN_SOURCE, "has failed because of a fatal error during realtime phase", and the ingestion update FAILED at analysis. No privilege message appeared.
cause: Schema exploration lists only the tables the login can read, so the flow finds the table missing.
effect: The message says the table is missing, not that a grant is missing.
fix: Grant SELECT on the table again, and check that schema exploration lists it. The regrant wasn't run in this round.
notes: With no visible tables at all, the gateway reported INGESTION_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_ERROR.SOURCE_CONNECTION_FAILURE, which is misleading.
